<script>window.addEventListener('load', () => {

    const links = document.querySelectorAll(
        '.sb__on_this_page_col #cnft__toc_links a'
    );

    const sections = [...links]
        .map(link => document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href')))
        .filter(Boolean);

    if (!sections.length) {
        console.warn('No matching sections found.');
        return;
    }

    const headerOffset = 260;

    function updateActiveLink() {

        let currentSection = sections[0];

        sections.forEach(section => {

            if (
                section.getBoundingClientRect().top <= headerOffset
            ) {
                currentSection = section;
            }

        });

        document.querySelectorAll(
            '.sb__on_this_page_col #cnft__toc_links li'
        ).forEach(li =>
            li.classList.remove('is-active')
        );

        document.querySelector(
            `.sb__on_this_page_col #cnft__toc_links a[href="#${currentSection.id}"]`
        )?.parentElement?.classList.add('is-active');
    }

    let ticking = false;

    function handleScroll() {

        if (!ticking) {

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                updateActiveLink();
                ticking = false;
            });

            ticking = true;
        }

    }

    updateActiveLink();

    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateActiveLink);

});</script><link rel="icon" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/cropped-mvcc-favicon-1-32x32.png" sizes="32x32">

/* J - LIVE PROCESS STEPS */
/* Base arrow */
.J--live--process-steps .process--step-col {
    position: relative;
}

.J--live--process-steps .process--step-col::before {
    content: '';
    width: 44px;
    height: 32px;
    display: block;
    position: absolute;
    background-image: url('/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/arrow-process.png');
    background-size: contain;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: center;
}

/* Right arrow */
.J--live--process-steps .process--step-col.arrow-right::before {
    top: 50%;
    left: 100%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
}

/* Down arrow */
.J--live--process-steps .process--step-col.arrow-down::before {
    left: 50%;
    top: calc(100% + 7px);
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(90deg);
}

/* Left arrow */
.J--live--process-steps .process--step-col.arrow-left::before {
    right: 100%;
    left: auto;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(180deg);
}

/* No arrow */
.J--live--process-steps .process--step-col.arrow-none::before {
    display: none;
}

/* 
Animated background for Artist of MV */

.aurora-gradient .fl-row-content-wrap {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #faf6f7; /* soft pink-white base */
}

/* Animated gradient layer */
.aurora-gradient .fl-row-content-wrap::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -40%;

  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 20%, rgba(255, 220, 225, 1), transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), transparent 60%);

  filter: blur(80px);
  opacity: 0.9;

  animation: auroraFloat 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

/* Keep content above */
.aurora-gradient .fl-row-content-wrap > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

@keyframes auroraFloat {
  0% {
    transform: translate(0%, 0%) scale(1);

</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-box fl-node-4o7jdavg0trx main__inner_content" data-node="4o7jdavg0trx" aria-label="Box">
	<div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-rich-text fl-node-pjyvkxhw8uqf" data-node="pjyvkxhw8uqf" aria-label="Text Editor">
	<p>Council meetings are where your elected Councillors meet to debate Council business, set strategic objectives and make decisions on behalf of the community.</p>
<p>You can find a copy of the agenda for all Council meetings on this page from late on the <em>Friday*</em> afternoon immediately before the scheduled meeting.</p>
<p>Minutes of Council meetings are published here in draft form on the <em>Friday*</em> immediately following the meeting. These remain in draft form until they are confirmed by Councillors at the next Council meeting.</p>
<p><em>*Applicable when meetings are scheduled on Tuesdays.</em></p>
<p>If you are looking for the Minutes or Agendas of meetings which took place prior to the 2018, please get in touch with our team at <a role="link" href="mailto:governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au">governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au</a> or on <a role="link" href="tel:0392438888">(03) 9243 8888</a> and we will be happy to provide these to you. Alternatively, you can watch Council meetings dating back to 2017 on our <a role="link" href="https://www.youtube.com/user/MooneeValleyCC/playlists">YouTube channel <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i></a>.</p>
</div>

<h3>Moonee Valley Racing Club Planning Assessment Special Committee - 10 October 2018</h3>
<p>The Moonee Valley Racing Club (MVRC) Planning Assessment Special Committee is a special committee of Council established in accordance with Section 86 of the Local Government Act 1989.</p>
<p>The Committee will consider, assess and make decisions on planning applications related to development at Moonee Valley Racecourse.</p>
<p>In accordance with its Instrument of Delegation, the MVRC Planning Assessment Special Committee has the authority to assess and determine planning applications submitted by MVRC in line with the Planning & Environment Act 1987.</p>
<p>The meeting will be held on Wednesday 10 October at 5.30pm at the Civic Centre, 9 Kellaway Avenue, Moonee Ponds (entrance via Pascoe Vale Road). The meeting is open to members of the public.</p>

<div class="fl-module fl-module-heading fl-node-wb01z6cx7kr2 main__content_title" data-node="wb01z6cx7kr2" aria-label="Heading">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<h2 class="fl-heading" id="attending-council-meetings">
			<span class="fl-heading-text">Attending Council meetings</span>
	</h2>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-box fl-node-wplgeqnahz3b main__inner_content" data-node="wplgeqnahz3b" aria-label="Box">
	<div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-4e7kifonlmtj" data-node="4e7kifonlmtj" aria-label="Text Editor">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-rich-text">
	<p>Those attending Council meetings are expected to behave respectfully at all times and must not interject and/or disrupt the meeting. Where there is a significant public interest in a particular matter, the order of business may be altered by the resolution of Council.</p>
</div>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-accordion fl-node-xgozjp9q1kan mycouncil--accordion" data-node="xgozjp9q1kan" aria-label="Accordion">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-accordion fl-accordion-small fl-accordion-collapse">
	<div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-0" aria-controls="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-0" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Accessibility information</a><a id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-icon-0" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-0" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-0"><div class="uabb-infobox-title-wrap">
<ul dir="ltr" type="disc">
<li dir="ltr"><span dir="ltr"><strong>Getting there</strong>:<b dir="ltr"> </b>The Civic Centre is within 100 metres of tram lines 59 and 82 as well as the Moonee Ponds Bus Interchange, which services a number of routes. Moonee Ponds Train Station is a 700 metre flat walk away. There is limited free parking available nearby, but they may fill up fast. Paid parking is available at Moonee Ponds Central. There are accessible parking bays in off-street area on Kellaway Ave, immediately behind Council Building via Pascoe Vale Road and one parallel park on Pascoe Vale Road.</span></li>
<li dir="ltr"><span dir="ltr">The Council Chambers are accessible by lift or stairs. An accessible toilet is available on site on the ground floor.</span></li>
<li dir="ltr"><span dir="ltr">A hearing assistance system has recently been installed in the Council Chambers. The new system allows users to hear amplified sound from the microphones in the room, via a headset. This system supports those with a hearing impairment to participate in Council meetings and other events held in the Council Chambers.</span></li>
<li dir="ltr"><span dir="ltr">For attending Council Meetings outside business hours, please use entrance on Pascoe Vale Road.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="uabb-infobox-text-wrap">
<div class="uabb-infobox-text uabb-text-editor"></div>
</div>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-1" aria-controls="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-1" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Recording of meetings</a><a id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-icon-1" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-1" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-1"><p>Members of the public must not, without the prior approval of the Chair, operate any audio or visual recording equipment at any Council meeting.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-2" aria-controls="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-2" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Chair may remove</a><a id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-icon-2" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-2" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-2"><p>The Chair may order and cause the removal of any person whose words or actions disrupt the meeting or who fails to comply with a direction from the Chair.</p>
<p>The Chair may request Victoria Police to escort out from the Chamber any person who acts in breach of the Governance Rules and whom the Chair has ordered to be removed from the Gallery.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-3" aria-controls="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-3" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Security</a><a id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-icon-3" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-3" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-3"><p>Those attending Council meetings may be asked to present bags for inspection by security staff, and the number of attendees may be capped if it reaches the capacity of the facility due to occupational health and safety requirements.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-4" aria-controls="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-4" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Penalties</a><a id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-icon-4" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-content-4" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-xgozjp9q1kan-button-4"><div class="uabb-infobox-title-wrap">
<p class="uabb-infobox-title">In accordance with our <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Governance-Local-Law-2020-Legal-Approved-Signed.pdf">Governance Local Law 2020 (PDF, 2 MB)</a>, to ensure peace, order and good government of Moonee Valley City Council and the efficient and orderly conduct of Meetings, it is an offence for any person (not being a Councillor), who has engaged in any improper or disorderly conduct to not leave the Meeting when requested by the Chair to do so; or any person to record the proceedings of a Meeting without the consent of the Chair; or any person to fail to obey a direction of the Chair relating to the conduct of the Meeting and the maintenance of order.</p>
</div>
<div class="uabb-infobox-text-wrap">
<div class="uabb-infobox-text uabb-text-editor">
<p>The penalties for such an offence can be found within Schedule 1 of the Moonee Valley City Council <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Governance-Local-Law-2020-Legal-Approved-Signed.pdf">Governance Local Law 2020 (PDF, 2 MB)</a> and the current penalty unit set by the <a role="link" href="https://www.dtf.vic.gov.au/financial-management-government/indexation-fees-and-penalties">Department of Treasury and Finance Victoria.</a></p>
</div>
</div>
</div></div></div>
	</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-heading fl-node-y3vs8ojb0p9l main__content_title" data-node="y3vs8ojb0p9l" aria-label="Heading">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<h2 class="fl-heading" id="public-questions">
			<span class="fl-heading-text">Public questions</span>
	</h2>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-box fl-node-n1plb57umoi3 main__inner_content" data-node="n1plb57umoi3" aria-label="Box">
	<h5 class="fl-module fl-module-heading fl-heading fl-heading-text fl-node-sgqbm1le87dn" data-node="sgqbm1le87dn" aria-label="Heading">
			Council meetings	</h5>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-khiruyaom1tj" data-node="khiruyaom1tj" aria-label="Text Editor">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-rich-text">
	<p>Council has made a commitment to provide time at each Council meeting for members of the public to ask questions. The process for public question time is outlined in <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/?wpdmdl=21531&ind=1598833596596">Council’s Governance Rules</a>.</p>
</div>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-accordion fl-node-z0cv6ylqj8gp mycouncil--accordion" data-node="z0cv6ylqj8gp" aria-label="Accordion">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-accordion fl-accordion-small fl-accordion-collapse">
	<div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-z0cv6ylqj8gp-button-0" aria-controls="fl-accordion-z0cv6ylqj8gp-content-0" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Public question guidelines</a><a id="fl-accordion-z0cv6ylqj8gp-icon-0" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-z0cv6ylqj8gp-content-0" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-z0cv6ylqj8gp-button-0"><p>Members of the public are asked to adhere to the following guidelines for asking questions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Public Question Time <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87400-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Question-Form.docx">forms (DOCX, 357 KB)</a> must be submitted <strong>by 12pm on the business day prior</strong> to the advertised date of the meeting, either via <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/my-council/council-meetings/#submit-question">Council’s website</a>, by email to <a role="link" href="mailto:governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au">governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au</a>, by hand at Council’s Civic Centre (9 Kellaway Avenue, Moonee Ponds) or by mail (PO Box 126 Moonee Ponds 3039).</li>
<li>A maximum of two questions are permitted from one person.</li>
<li>*As per Council’s <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/?wpdmdl=21531&ind=1598833596596">Governance Rules</a>, a question may be disallowed by the Chair if the Chair determines that it:
<ul>
<li>Relates to a matter outside the duties, functions and powers of Council</li>
<li>is defamatory, indecent, abusive, offensive, irrelevant, trivial or objectionable in language or substance;</li>
<li>deals with a subject matter already answered;</li>
<li>is aimed at embarrassing a Councillor or a member of</li>
<li>Council staff;</li>
<li>relates to personnel matters; or</li>
<li>relates to confidential information as defined in section 3(1) of the <em>Local Government Act 2020.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>The Chair will have the discretion to paraphrase questions for the purpose of clarity or brevity.</li>
<li>To ensure the integrity of Public Question Time, your identity must be confirmed prior to the question being tabled for a response. If you are unable to confirm your identity we will not process the question for Council response.</li>
</ul>
<p>Reading our <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87400-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Question-Form.docx">guidelines for public question time found at the end of the Public Question Time form (docx, 357KB)</a>, is recommended before submitting your question to Council.</p>
</div></div></div>
	</div>
</div>
<h5 class="fl-module fl-module-heading fl-heading fl-heading-text fl-node-r0x6m4vq1unh" data-node="r0x6m4vq1unh" aria-label="Heading">
			Public forum	</h5>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-0rfvjd9cxuwp" data-node="0rfvjd9cxuwp" aria-label="Text Editor">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-rich-text">
	<p>On the third Tuesday of every month*, Council hosts a public forum at 6pm*. Public forums take place in a less formal setting than Council meetings, and provide another opportunity for residents to play a role in civic matters.</p>
</div>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-accordion fl-node-j1p60a5982tm mycouncil--accordion" data-node="j1p60a5982tm" aria-label="Accordion">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-accordion fl-accordion-small fl-accordion-collapse">
	<div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-button-0" aria-controls="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-content-0" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Public Forum Access Guidelines</a><a id="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-icon-0" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-content-0" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-button-0"><p>Residents are invited to register to present or raise any issues or matters they would like to present to Councillors. For further information please read the Public Forum Access Guidelines on the <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87399-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Forum-Access-Form.docx">last page of the form (DOCX, 356KB)</a>.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-button-1" aria-controls="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-content-1" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Public forum 2026 dates</a><a id="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-icon-1" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-content-1" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-j1p60a5982tm-button-1"><p>Tuesday, 17 February</p>
<p>Tuesday, 17 March</p>
<p>Tuesday, 21 April</p>
<p>Tuesday, 19 May</p>
<p>Tuesday, 16 June</p>
<p>Tuesday, 21 July</p>
<p>Tuesday, 18 August</p>
<p>Tuesday, 15 September</p>
<p>Tuesday, 20 October</p>
<p>Tuesday, 17 November</p>
<p><em>*The time, day and date of the public forum is subject to change in accordance with Governance Rule 11.1</em></p>
</div></div></div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-heading fl-node-7nvw3hg69xfu main__content_title" data-node="7nvw3hg69xfu" aria-label="Heading">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<h2 class="fl-heading" id="submit-your-question">
			<span class="fl-heading-text">Submit your question</span>
	</h2>
	</div>

<div class="fl-module fl-module-box fl-node-d1enr35w6ptb main__inner_content" data-node="d1enr35w6ptb" aria-label="Box">
	<div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-moxqwibfndjv checklist_content" data-node="moxqwibfndjv" aria-label="Text Editor">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-rich-text">
	<p>The easiest way to register to ask Council a question at a Council meeting or public forum is to fill out the form below.  If you would prefer, you can also download the <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87399-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Forum-Access-Form.docx">Public Forum Access Form (DOCX, 356 KB)</a> or the <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87400-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Question-Form.docx">Public Question Time Form (DOCX, 357 KB)</a> (for Council meetings) and email it to <a role="link" href="mailto:governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au">governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au</a> by midday on the business day before the meeting at which you intend to ask your question.</p>
<p>Please ensure you have read the relevant guidelines available on the last page of each form before making your submission.</p>
<ul>
<li><a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87400-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Question-Form.docx">Public Question Time at a Council Meeting guidelines (DOCX, 356 KB)</a></li>
<li><a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/22-87399-Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Public-Forum-Access-Form.docx">Public Forum Guidelines (DOCX, 357 KB)</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Once you have submitted your question, a member of our Legal & Governance team will get in touch with you to discuss further.</p>
</div>
	</div>
</div>

For further information on how your personal information is handled, refer to <a href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/footer/privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Council’s Information Privacy and Security Policy<span class="fl-new-tab-notice sr-only">(opens in new tab)</span></a> at or email <a href="mailto:privacy@mvcc.vic.gov.au">privacy@mvcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>

<div class="fl-module fl-module-heading fl-node-3y48aokdrc1t main__content_title" data-node="3y48aokdrc1t" aria-label="Heading">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<h2 class="fl-heading" id="petitions-and-joint-letters">
			<span class="fl-heading-text">Petitions and joint letters</span>
	</h2>
	</div>
</div>
<div class="fl-module fl-module-box fl-node-efm1kc40otzx main__inner_content" data-node="efm1kc40otzx" aria-label="Box">
	<div class="fl-module fl-module-accordion fl-node-8hxawv0927eq mycouncil--accordion" data-node="8hxawv0927eq" aria-label="Accordion">
	<div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content">
		<div class="fl-accordion fl-accordion-small fl-accordion-collapse">
	<div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-0" aria-controls="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-0" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">What is a petition?</a><a id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-icon-0" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-0" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-0"><p>A petition is a written request to Council which has been signed by multiple people (who each provide their name and street address). Petitions express concern about an issue and request Council to take action.</p>
<p>Any person may organise a petition and request that it be received at a Meeting of Council.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-1" aria-controls="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-1" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">What is a joint letter?</a><a id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-icon-1" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-1" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-1"><p>A joint letter is a letter signed by more than one person. A joint letter can address any subject, and while it does not need to be in the formal written format of a petition, it must contain the 'prayer' or request of the signatories.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-2" aria-controls="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-2" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">What does a petition or joint letter look like?</a><a id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-icon-2" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-2" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-2"><p>A petition or joint letter presented to Council should have the following format:</p>
<ul>
<li>be in writing, typing or printing, and contain the request of the petitioners or signatories</li>
<li>be signed by the persons whose names are provided, with the address or email address of every petitioner clearly stated;</li>
<li>clearly state, <em>on each page of the petition</em>, the issue of concern you would like to bring to the notice of Council;</li>
<li>in the case of electronic petitions or joint letters, the name and email address of each petitioner will function as the petitioner's 'signature';</li>
<li>Does not contain the following:
<ul>
<li>defamatory, indecent, abusive or offensive in language or substance;</li>
<li>beyond Council’s power;</li>
<li>would expose Council to unreasonable legal risk;</li>
<li>would result in Council otherwise acting invalidly; or</li>
<li>identical or substantially similar to a petition or joint letter that has been tabled by Council in the preceding six months</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>A petition or joint letter will not be accepted if it contains a complaint against the actions or failures of Council staff or department. This will be treated as a letter of complaint and will be handled in accordance with Council’s Complaint Management Policy.</p>
<p>Download the <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Petition-Guidelines.docx">petition and joint letter guidelines (DOCX, 37 KB)</a>, including a sample petition template.</p>
<p>The petition must nominate a contact person. If you are the organiser of a petition, please include your contact details so that the relevant Council officer can contact you to acknowledge the receipt of the petition, and advise you after the petition has been received at a Council meeting.</p>
<p>It is the responsibility of the petition organiser to contact other signatories to the petition to inform them of its progress.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-3" aria-controls="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-3" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">How do I submit a petition or joint letter?</a><a id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-icon-3" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-3" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-3"><p>Once the petition or joint letter is complete, email to <a role="link" href="mailto:governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au">governance@mvcc.vic.gov.au</a>, or send to:</p>
<p><strong>Moonee Valley City Council</strong><br>
<strong>Attn: Governance</strong><br>
<strong>PO Box 126, Moonee Ponds VIC 3039</strong></p>
<p>You can also deliver your petition or joint letter to the Civic Centre at 9 Kellaway Avenue, Moonee Ponds.</p>
<p>In order to be included in the meeting agenda, your petition or joint letter must be received two weeks prior to the meeting date and comply with the <a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Petition-Guidelines.docx">Petition Guidelines (DOCX, 37 KB)</a>. You may also arrange for a petition or joint letter to be tabled closer to the Council Meeting date by approaching a Councillor and asking them to support your petition or joint letter by tabling it directly at the meeting. This means the petition or joint letter will not appear on the meeting agenda.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-4" aria-controls="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-4" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">What will happen after I submit a petition or joint letter?</a><a id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-icon-4" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-4" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-4"><p>Once we receive your petition or joint letter, we will arrange for it to be 'tabled' (formally received) at a Council meeting by a ward councillor.</p>
<p>It will then be referred to an officer for review and action. The Council officer will address the issues of concern with the lead petitioner in writing.</p>
</div></div><div class="fl-accordion-item"><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-5" aria-controls="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-5" aria-expanded="false" role="button" tabindex="0" class="fl-accordion-button"><a class="fl-accordion-button-label" role="none">Privacy</a><a id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-icon-5" class="fl-accordion-button-icon fl-accordion-button-icon-right" role="none" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fl-accordion-button-icon dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-label-icon="dashicons dashicons-before dashicons-arrow-down-alt2" data-active-icon="ua-icon ua-icon-chevron-small-up"><span class="sr-only">Expand</span></i></a></div><div id="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-content-5" class="fl-accordion-content fl-clearfix" role="region" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="fl-accordion-8hxawv0927eq-button-5"><p>In presenting a petition or joint letter to a Council meeting, a report will be prepared which provides a summary of the petition or joint letter (such as the number of signatures and the topic of the letter or petition). The report will not contain personal information such as petition signatures, names and addresses.</p>
<p><a role="link" href="https://mvcc.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Corporate-Document-ACTIVE-Information-Privacy-Policy.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View our Information Privacy Policy (PDF, 265 KB)<span class="fl-new-tab-notice sr-only">(opens in new tab)</span></a></p>
</div></div></div>
	</div>
</div>
